item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Effect Sizes, Statistical Power and Meta-Research: New Tools for Psychological Research (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

The research program focuses on the development of advanced statistical methods for psychological research, with particular emphasis on effect sizes, statistical power and meta-research. Planned activities include simulation studies, development of R applications for data analysis and meta-analyses. The program is framed within the broader context of Open Science and FAIR data principles, aiming to provide researchers with practical tools for more informed study planning

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: The OPEN Bilingual-Advantage Replicability project (OPEN BAR) (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-23 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

There are replicability issues with studies that suggest that people who speak more than one language have an advantage in attentional control efficiency compared to those who only speak one. This job involves addressing these issues in two ways: 1) by enabling the replicability of studies reporting a bilingual advantage through the systematic collection and organization of their data, materials, and code for publication within a web app open to the scientific community; 2) by estimating the replicability of the results reported in those studies through the direct replication of a behavioral sample of them, primarily in the healthy adult population, following the registered report format.…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Notice of expression of interest-Recording of the activity of memory and visual perception neurons in the macaque and their behavioral correlates (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

Perception and memory rely on many of the same brain systems, making it hard to tell where one ends and the other begins. This blur is made even more complex by the brain’s processing of visual information. The ERC-funded SteerMEM project aims to explain the relationship between visual perception and memory in monkeys. Specifically, it will use electrophysiology, intracortical microstimulation, and AI to explore the inferotemporal cortex and perirhinal cortex in macaque monkeys. It will study the neural mechanisms underlying these. The findings will shed light on the boundary between perception and memory and test whether specific PrC neurons can create familiarity without visual input. The…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Disentangling psychological interventions for mental disorders into a taxonomy of active ingredients (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

Psychological interventions for severe mental disorders are generally effective treatment options combined with other interventions, but crucial aspects related to mechanisms and personalization are still unexplored. The complexity of cases such as psychotic, bipolar, substance use, eating and borderline personality requires knowledge of mechanisms of change and a more individualised approach, beyond theapplication of one-size-fit-all treatment packages.
